items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Two questions on the Blakey thing. I want to know why you left. But, I also want to know how important, maybe it wasn't important, but how important the thinking, or the mindset that he had early on when they adopted Islam. Did that play out? Because, it wasn't a public scenario for him after the initial big band that he had where several guys were converted. But, this seems to be on undertone of guys who were influenced and took that practice, or what they learned, out of Islam seriously. But, it wasn't a public…

Well, the first time I left, it was because principal players left. I found that I couldn't right this ship; it was unbalanced. Good players, I mean he brought in different players, you know? It wasn't sincere anymore. John Hicks is a great player but, it wasn't serious anymore. Victor Sproles…
